Geography 219
National _ Highways
They are constructed and maintained by the central government
The National _ Highways has 71,772 km; length comprising only 2% of the
total _ length of roads, carries about 40% of the total traffic of India.
The central government has taken up in phased manner during
2005-2012 an expanded programme of 4/6 lanning of 12,109 kms:
National Highways (NH) under the National Highways Development
Programme (NHDP) On Build, Operate and Transfer (BOT) basis
'Special Accelerated Road Development Programme for North-East
(SARDPNEY has been taken up The two phased (Phase-Aand Phase-B)
programmeincludes improving 6418km ofroads (including2319km. of
roads under Arunachal Package) The Phase-A is likely to be completed
during 2010-17. Phase-B involves two-laning of 3723 km: of roads_
